IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 tokenizer/preproc latency SLO breached for /v1/generate-stream in prod-us-east-1. Current p95=610ms (SLO 300ms), p99=1.8s. Affected customers: 3 high-volume tenants. Paging oncall now.

Lina (oncall): Taking this. oncall pinged, I'll drive. Lina -> Maria handing off.

Maria (eng-sre): Thanks. quick snapshot: spike started at 12:03 UTC, correlates with deploy? No deploys in window per deploy-bot. Seeing big tail on streaming requests with content-type: application/json (JSON-mode).

Sam (runtime): Noted. Which component is hot? tokenizer or preproc? I see CPU for preproc-worker pool climb to 85%. KVcache pressure low.

Cheng (ml-infra): Looking at traces. Majority of slow traces show heavy time in prompt_builder -> template_expander -> tokenizer. The JSON-mode validator runs schema.resolve() per-tool which is expensive for nested tool schemas.

Eli (support): We already got two customer chats reporting streaming stalls and spikes in time-to-first-token. One tenant (acme-inc) saw 5xx -> streaming disconnects.

Maria (eng-sre): Concrete numbers from metrics: p95 tokenization_time = 420ms, p99 tokenization_time = 1.6s. end-to-end p95 = 610ms. So tokenization is dominant.

Sam (runtime): I can repro locally with large tool schema + JSON-mode. Looks like template rendering expands tool args into a huge prompt, then JSON-mode runs full tokenization + pretty-print verification which is O(n^2) in worst case for nested arrays. Patch idea: short-circuit the heavy validation for streaming path or add incremental tokenizer.

Cheng (ml-infra): Quick logs from worker-12: ```[2026-03-14T12:05:23Z] request_id=abc123 prompt_len_chars=3200 prompt_tokens_est=245 tokenization_ms=680 template_render_ms=120 schema_validate_ms=240 total_preproc_ms=1040```

Lina (oncall): Impact scope please. How many requests/hr affected and which routes?

Maria (eng-sre): ~1200 requests in last 10m for /v1/generate-stream with content-type JSON-mode. Affected tenants were on dedicated and hosted. Error bursts show streaming disconnects at client-side after 30s.

Eli (support): Notified account managers. We should offer mitigations ASAP.

Sam (runtime): Immediate mitigation options: 1) Toggle fast-path: disable JSON-mode for streaming endpoints globally (config flag). 2) Deploy a hotfix that skips deep schema.resolve() for large schemas (>50 nodes). 3) Apply rate-limit/burst policy for tenants hitting >100rps.

Cheng (ml-infra): I can push config change to disable JSON-mode on streaming routes in prod-us-east quickly (no code deploy). That will reduce validation cost but may affect users relying on strict JSON-mode.

Maria (eng-sre): Do it. While Cheng prepares, I'll add a temporary routing rule to send heavy requests to lower-priority pool to avoid cascading latency.

Lina (oncall): Cheng, go ahead. Sam, stand by to monitor infra after flip. Eli, let support know about temporary opt-out and we can revert once hotfix is validated.

Cheng (ml-infra): Flipping flag now: `infra-config set streaming.json_mode.enabled=false --env prod-us-east` -> rolled to 3/3 hosts.

IncidentBot: Config change applied by Cheng. Change-id=cfg-20260314-01.

Sam (runtime): Metrics live: tokenization p95 dropped from 610ms -> 240ms within 90s. p99 -> 720ms. streaming error rate down 85%.

Maria (eng-sre): Nice. Customer-facing impact reduced. Now plan for medium-term fix: Sam to prepare hotfix to skip deep schema validation for streaming path and add schema size guard; Cheng to add telemetry for schema node counts and tokenization-time per-request; Lina to keep monitoring for 2 hours then handback to oncall rotation.

Sam (runtime): I'll cut a PR with two changes: (A) short-circuit JSON-mode validator when schema_nodes > 50 for streaming endpoints; (B) add incremental tokenizer cache keyed by template hash to avoid re-tokenizing common templates.

Cheng (ml-infra): I'll add a new metric: preproc.schema_nodes_count and emit histogram for tokenization_ms by schema_nodes bucket.

Eli (support): Drafting message to impacted customers: explain transient spike, mitigation applied (JSON-mode disabled on streaming), ETA for fix ~48h, offer rollback to prior rate limits if needed.

Lina (oncall): After 2h stable, we'll re-enable JSON-mode only for test tenants and then progressively rollout with canary. For now incident severity -> Sev2 (customer impact, mitigation in place). I'll file postmortem once PR merged and telemetry collected.

Sam (runtime): Quick note: while JSON-mode off for streaming, non-streaming endpoints still have full validation. We'll need communications to ext teams to avoid surprise.

Maria (eng-sre): Agreed. Also add an alert to trigger when tokenization p95 > 400ms for >5m in prod-us-east.

IncidentBot: Oncall handoff reminder: Lina will remain primary until 14:30 UTC. Next oncall: Daniel.

Eli (support): Logged incident to CS tracker INC-2026-0314, assigned to Eli. Sent preliminary messages to affected accounts.

Cheng (ml-infra): I've deployed schema telemetry patch to canary and started a 1% rollout. Sam, once your PR is ready we can test on canary before full deploy.

Sam (runtime): PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4823 - CI green. Requesting review from Maria and Cheng. This implements schema node guard + template-hash tokenizer cache (in-memory, TTL 5m).

Maria (eng-sre): Reviewed, looks ok. We'll coordinate canary deploy after change window.

Lina (oncall): Marking thread: ongoing. Will update every 15m or on major milestone. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Eli (support): Customer note posted. Will update if any escalations.

Sam (runtime): Posting simple repro snippet for reviewers: ```python
# reproduce heavy json-mode prompt
template = open('big_tool_schema.json').read()
request = {
  "mode": "json",
  "template": template,
  "input": {"items": [[... repeated nested arrays ...]]}
}
resp = session.post('/v1/generate-stream', json=request)
```

Maria (eng-sre): Logging this as incident 2026-03-14-tokenizer-jsonmode. We'll archive metrics and attach repro to postmortem.

IncidentBot: Thread locked to channel members for live incident coordination.

Lina (oncall): End update for now. Next breake: 12:25 UTC.

Sam (runtime): Noted. Monitoring continues.

-- end of thread --
